decisions.reason: The cobot loading system is a recent, low-cost extension of the established machining offer that fits the firm's automation strategy, and its value is still uncertain, so keeping the option is cheap and worthwhile.

The dual-table loading system builds on existing machines and adds little carrying cost, and with its prospects still unresolved after only a year on the market, the option is worth more than keeping it costs.

The dispensing machine is a flagship with its own page and a Red Dot award, so early signals are positive, and although it is distant from the core business, the firm is expanding and investing behind it as a growth option.
